summary: Feed s052_single to IDS is degraded due to significant packet loss: 9.0% of TCP packets (143/1583) show missing data, well above 1% threshold. IDS flow reassembly and signature matching will be impaired. All other checks (duplicates, encryption, VLAN, one-way, oversize, overload, truncation, tunnels) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Upstream capture is dropping packets before delivery to IDS. With tool_overload healthy, loss is not IDS ingress policing but earlier - typically SPAN/mirror oversubscription or packet broker buffer exhaustion under bursts, causing gaps in TCP sequences.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires both directions and full payload for TCP reassembly and signature detection. 9% missing data breaks reassembly, causes missed exploits, evasion opportunities, and incomplete logging/alerting.

recommended_fix.why: Passive TAP provides lossless line-rate copy unlike SPAN which drops under load. If TAP already present, add broker filtering or load-balancing to keep aggregate throughput within lossless forwarding capacity.
